The indicator function $\mathbf{1}[P]$ equals $1$ if the predicate $P$ is true and $0$ if $P$ is false.
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14210051/assets/b1a45cb38a9a19c9dac7a7736cb71f2ad0cef5b7026f3eeb6bc573ee11609db4.svg)

Here, the predicate is $9 > 7.$ Since $9$ is greater than $7,$ the predicate is true. Therefore, 

$$
\mathbf{1}[9 > 7] = 1.
$$
